heard: In August 1814, British forces marched into Washington, D.C. On August 24, American militia forces fled in a panic. Tenant Paul Jennings helped save George Washington's portrait. Major General Robert Ross ordered the White House torched. The Library of Congress burned as the sky darkened. Suddenly, a devastating storm struck the Capitol. Torrential rains extinguished the flames. Destruction finally ended as British forces marched into Washington, D.C.
